# A CV-SHAPED FIXTURE, DELIBERATELY FICTIONAL.
#
# This replaces a real person's CV that used to live in a GITIGNORED nodes/ directory while
# the test suite read from it — so a fresh clone could not run the tests, and moving the file
# in as-is would have committed a phone number and a personal email address to a public
# repository that publishes to npm.
#
# What the test actually needs is the SHAPE, and every awkward thing about it is kept:
#   - a CONTINUED #+AUTHOR (the trailing \\ and a second #+AUTHOR line),
#   - a #+SETUPFILE naming a file that DOES NOT EXIST — the original's did not either, and a
#     missing setupfile must warn rather than throw,
#   - #+OPTIONS switching off the toc, numbering and the date,
#   - raw LaTeX spacing macros scattered through the body, which are not Org constructs and
#     must survive as text rather than crashing the parser,
#   - headlines used as section rules rather than as an outline.
